request.style: English, Deep male baritone voice with gritty blues texture, solo vocal, slide guitar, upright bass, brushed snare drums, piano, mournful minor key, slow tempo at 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Johanan came to Mizpah with the commanders
He spoke of a plot that hung in the air
Baalis king of Ammon had sent a man
Ishmael son of Nethaniah was the danger

[Verse]
He said strike him down before he strikes you
Scatter the Judeans who gather around
But Gedaliah refused to believe the news
He said the words about Ishmael are not true

[Chorus]
Baalis king of Ammon sent the blade
To kill the governor appointed by fate
The remnant of Judah is left to bleed
While Ishmael son of Nethaniah leads the deed

[Verse]
In the seventh month they sat to eat
Ten men rose up with the sword at their feet
Gedaliah fell and the Chaldeans died
The fighting men who stood by his side

[Chorus]
Baalis king of Ammon sent the blade
To kill the governor appointed by fate
The remnant of Judah is left to bleed
While Ishmael son of Nethaniah leads the deed

[Bridge]
Ishmael fled with eight men to Ammon
Back to the king who had set the plan
The remnant moved toward the land of Egypt
Afraid of the Chaldeans and the debt they might pay

[Outro]
They did not obey the voice of the Lord
And went to Tahpanhes with the sword
They did not obey the voice of the Lord
